metadata.llm_reason: Zone Index Construction is a distinct indexing capability focused on building and encoding zone-based metadata structures (author, title, abstract, language fields). It operates at the index_build stage and is orthogonal to peer candidates: it differs from zone weight learning (model_training stage), weighted zone scoring (retrieval stage), and vector space scoring (different method_family). The skill has clear support from academic IR literature (Cambridge UP section 6.1) and addresses a specific, well-defined objective with no conflicts.
